doc.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025

title: Arranging Pepsi spots with the Four Tops and Motown acts
summary: She wrote the charts and vocals and recorded the Four Tops, Martha and the Vandellas and others.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Well when you say you did it with them, so a chart was written —
An instrumental chart, you wrote the chart, and then you write the vocal parts and then you have them come in and you sing them the parts or whatever it takes to make this happen.

Yes. We did the tracks first. We were, by then, in at least four track I believe, and so it could — we could do the tracks and they came in from Detroit, the Tops did, and they called and said, “Do you want our arranger to do it” and they said, “No, we have our own arranger” and that was me. So you can imagine when I don’t know whether Berry Gordy was there with the Tops and their manager come in and see that there’s this little chick out there. And so I did the Tops and whatchacallit Martha, Jackie DeShannon, [scats] what’s his name, I can’t think. But anyway I’ll have to send you the Pepsi history.
